# Davis Vantage Pro2 wired ISS (6322C) packets, captured from the production station.
#
# Provenance: extracted from Logs/Detail Error log.txt on pi@weather, 2026-08-06. That file
# accumulates the last raw packet once a minute, but only while uploads have been failing for
# 5+ minutes, so this corpus is an accidental by-product of real incidents between 2026-02-17
# and 2026-08-06 -- including a 1.8" rain day. It is not reproducible on demand.
#
# One packet per line, 8 bytes, space-separated hex. Deduplicated and sorted.
# Four packets fail CRC; they are kept deliberately and must keep failing.
#
# Packet type is the high nibble of byte 0:
#   0x3  UNKNOWN/corrupt     1 packets (0 pass CRC)
#   0x4  UV                119 packets (119 pass CRC)
#   0x5  rain seconds      360 packets (360 pass CRC)
#   0x6  solar             137 packets (137 pass CRC)
#   0x8  temperature       674 packets (673 pass CRC)
#   0x9  wind gust         140 packets (140 pass CRC)
#   0xA  humidity          343 packets (343 pass CRC)
#   0xB  UNKNOWN/corrupt     1 packets (0 pass CRC)
#   0xD  UNKNOWN/corrupt     1 packets (0 pass CRC)
#   0xE  rain counter      349 packets (349 pass CRC)
#
# Note 0x4 and 0x6 are present in quantity: this station has no solar or UV sensor,
# but the ISS transmits the slots anyway with 0xFF (SENSOR_OFFLINE) in byte 3.
# The decoders return 0 for those and Weather_Station accepts them. That behaviour is
# load-bearing -- see AUDIT_PLAN items 8, 9, 19 and the R1/R6 warnings.
#
